title: Check AUV/AGV overall fleet status using the “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI pop-up titled “Overall System AGV Status” to confirm the current overall AGV/AUV system status is populated and capture the displayed overall status wording/values for troubleshooting context.
when_to_use: When you need a first confirmation of whether the overall AGV/AUV system status page is populated and what overall status it reports (e.g., to establish whether the system appears reachable vs overall-down/unreachable).
not_for: Do not use this procedure to deep-dive a single AGV’s active error/fault details; this procedure is only for the overall fleet/system status pop-up.
Do not use this procedure as a substitute for deeper diagnostics if the pop-up is blank/unreachable.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the RMS / fleet status UI, verify the “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up is populated, and record the displayed overall status wording/values.

visual_references.description: Frame showing the pop-up title “Overall System AGV Status” and the statement that the page shows the current status.

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up
steps.purpose: Get to the correct overall fleet/system status pop-up so you can verify whether it is populated and capture the displayed overall status.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), open the pop-up/page titled “Overall System AGV Status”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up/page is opened and visible.
steps.healthy_condition: The pop-up/page titled “Overall System AGV Status” is reachable and displayed.
steps.failure_condition: The pop-up/page cannot be opened (unreachable) or you cannot reach the “Overall System AGV Status” view.

actions.label: Open “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up

steps.title: Verify the “Overall System AGV Status” page is populated (not blank/unavailable)
steps.purpose: Determine whether the overall status view is currently providing data (reachable) versus blank/unavailable (overall-down/unreachable symptom).
steps.instruction: On the “Overall System AGV Status” page, confirm the page shows current status details (i.e., the status content is present rather than blank/unreachable).
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System AGV Status” page shows current overall AGV/AUV status details (not blank/unavailable).
steps.healthy_condition: Status content is present on the “Overall System AGV Status” page (the page is not blank/unreachable).
steps.failure_condition: The “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up/page is blank or unavailable.

actions.label: Check for populated status content
actions.exact_action: Confirm the page is showing current status details (i.e., the status content is present rather than blank/unreachable).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the pop-up cannot be opened or the page content is blank/unavailable, treat this as an overall system-down/unreachable symptom and stop further deep-dive checks in this procedure.

steps.instruction: Record the displayed overall status value(s) shown on the “Overall System AGV Status” page using the exact on-screen wording/fields present.
steps.expected_result: You have captured the displayed overall status value(s)/wording from the “Overall System AGV Status” pop-up.
steps.healthy_condition: The recorded values match the on-screen overall status details currently shown on the page.
steps.failure_condition: No status values/wording are available to record because the page is blank/unavailable.
